messages.subject: Fortran version
parts:
Hi Mike,

I was also wondering, what version of Fortran is the Niche Mapper source code written in?

There seems to be a few different versions, and I am not sure if there would be any possible compatibility issues between them, if we want to try and customise some of the code, for our study species.

All the best,
Matt

messages.author: 6cec8ea3702ece93
messages.subject: Re: Fortran version
parts:
Hi Matt,

It is essentially Fortran77 with some Fortran90/95 features. It uses modules and dynamically allocated arrays which are Fortran90 features.

Main thing is that the code is fixed-format in that it allows lines only of a certain length that must start a tab in. You shouldn't have any trouble if you simply modify the existing code. I use Simply Fortran as a programming environmnet.

All the best,
Mike
